change: Quick radial fan-out and simplified joystick feedback
behavior: Circular mode fans its segments outward from a fixed center in 120ms and retracts in 80ms, with a small per-sector stagger. Canvas drawing and layer transforms read animation state, keeping layout/hit geometry fixed and commands enabled immediately during entry. The popup stays alive for exit; commands are disabled while closing, a center tap reverses closing, and target/ownership changes remove it immediately. The transition uses the framework MotionDurationScale; installed Compose source was inspected to confirm Android animator-duration-scale integration. The joystick icon now has a filled center and stronger directional markers. The live movement overlay omits arrow glyphs, retaining its thumb dot and directional highlight. Discrete arrow popup keys and accessibility actions remain.
test_notes: Four JVM tests passed. The combined UI run passed eighteen of nineteen cases. The new pane-switch fixture froze the clock before its initial wheel appeared; waiting for that initial render corrected the fixture, and its pane/ownership cancellation test passed separately. All nineteen distinct UI cases passed across runs, including new frozen-clock entry/exit and quick-reversal checks. No production changes followed the combined run. No new full-frame performance measurements were made.
